sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 6430.5 ± 58.5 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe the same construct: full-length human FPR3 with a C-terminal rho1D4 epitope tag (TETSQVAPA) preceded by a GG linker, expressed in HEK293S stable cell lines and detected by Western blot. The C-terminus of FPR3 is residue 353 (M), which falls within the intracellular span 307–353 per the authoritative topology landmarks. This is a tolerated insertion on the cytoplasmic face, not the extracellular face, and therefore does not qualify as a surface tag site. No ledger line supports any tag insertion at an extracellular position (N-terminus residues 1–27, ECL1 84–100, ECL2 163–205, or ECL3 267–286). Zero extracellular sites are supported by the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal rho1D4 tag (TETSQVAPA + GG linker) appended after residue 353 (M) of full-length FPR3; topology landmarks place residues 307–353 in the intracellular compartment; tag is tolerated (detected by Western blot in stable HEK293S clones) but faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
